breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses ω = 2π(rpm/60) to convert rpm to radians per second, computing ω = 2π(1200/60) = 125.66 rad/s. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction of substituting rpm directly as ω. This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
